top_choice_rationale: P003 is the only proposal in which a quantitative theoretical prediction (flat bands at a magic angle, 2011) was followed by an experimental discovery at that angle (2018) and independent replication across moire systems, and its citation separates the theory and experiment clauses so that it credits the discovery rather than a leadership role. The unsettled pairing mechanism does not undermine the discovery of correlated states, though the omission of Cao and the hBN device groups is a real attribution weakness. If the committee will not accept it, the mature lattice-Hubbard field in P004 (mixed theory and experiment) is the best fallback, then P005, then the cleanly credited clock prize P001; P002 rests on a leadership-based allocation I cannot defend by scientific contribution; no award is ranked last because several candidates are mature.
